name: Grass Goblin
note:
<tjsLevel:1>
<cgmzdesc:
Grass Goblins are simple-minded, short and small humanoid creatures that are obnoxious, filthy, unsanitary, and hate humans and other people from human civilizations (including half-zarakites and zarakites, becuase such draco people associate with and integrate with human culture so much.)

Grass Goblins have their "whacking clubs" that can hurt only so much, and carry shields that make them even more obnoxious as it protects them so that they take only 75% of physical damage they would otherwise suffer.  They have tough, rubbery and smelly skin, which is slightly resistant to fire, but weak against Ice and cold-based attacks and weak against holy power of Light.

Grass Goblins pose a minor threat, typically.  It still feels refreshing to smack one dead though, like a cockroach.  They tend to be mindless and blindly start fights with those who can crush them easily, with next-to-no-brains zeal.  If they ask to be smacked down and punished a lesson, you might as well give them what they ask for.

They DO enjoy getting their hands on dragon skin, and happily skin severed and stolen zarakite dragon parts for their shields, clothing, blankets, drum heads, and more.  Despite having IQ scores that are down in the toilet, they are decent at crafting such things, woodworking, carving, and leatherworking, especially with a teenage dragon boy's skin.
>

name: Giant Greenfield Scorpion
note:
<tjsLevel:2>
<tjsLevel:2>
<tjsMeleeLevel:2>
<tjsMelee2Level:2>
<tjsBookLevel:2>
<tjsGunLevel:2>
<cgmzdesc:
Non-sentient giant vermin that prowl around in the outdoor grass, these creatures stay out of mowed lawns because in such places the grass is too short to hide themselves in.  There are things that parents tell their kids in Acrydia when it comes to chores and mowing the lawn, "Son, make sure you mow the lawn this weekend so we don't get those giant green scorpions."

If you encounter one, well, guess what.  Now you've seen one.  Note that they WILL eat your pet dog, and they WILL snip off your body parts if you're a typical everyday person.

Giant Greenfield Scorpions can attack once extra about a third of the time.  Also, they have a hard outer exoskeletal shell that makes them suffer only two-thirds damage from physical attacks.

These creatures are mildly resistant to ice and earth-based attacks, highly resistant to water-based attacks (They swim, and they have gills as well as lungs!), and they are easily hurt from fire-based attacks that injure them with double the normal damage.  Due to the firebreathing abilities of zarakites and half-zarakites, they have evolved, through natural selection and survival of the fittest, to fear and be especially aggressive towards such dragons and half-dragons.  They will flee from the roar of a zarakite dragon - which half-zarakites are incapable of - but when it comes to half-dragon teenage kids like you, \P[1], they have a tendancy to want to kill and decapitate kids like you as soon as possible before you breath fire on them.  (A lot of wild, non-sentient creatures that are vulnerable to fire are like this in this world, not just the outskirts of Acrydia that go into the countryside, so you might as well get used to it, \P[1].)

These scorpions don't have any poison in their stingers that will poison you if you are hurt by one.  On the other hand, that stinger at the end of their tail DOES do something - It stings with a nasty but fortunately short-acting acid that inflicts acid burns for a couple of turns or so after getting hurt by it.

Aside from their acid sting attack, their pincer claws can and will swiftly snip off toes, feet, fingers and hands quite easily.  They also have a knack for snipping through the neck of reckless energetic teenage dragon boys that fight so fast and reckless that they don't have their defenses up too much in favor of making many strikes, like you \P[1], and against such dragon kids happily decapitating with a single quick SNIP that pops off such a dragon boy's head, near-instantaneously solving any issues he may have if he found he was a head too tall for something...
>

name: Wild Sheep
note:
<tjsLevel:1>
<cgmzdesc:
Awwwww...  Just look at the cute and innocent widdle sheep...  How cute...

...Maybe you could pet it...

...Until a moment later:  "OW!!!!!  Friggn' psycho animal!!!!!  What the ****!?"

Okay, they look cute, but you gotta understand that they aren't exactly domesticated.  They're FERAL, thank you, and they WILL bite and kick.  They aren't very dangerous, and are hardly any threat, but they're wild and feral like that, got it \P[1]?  Good.

As far as any strengths or weaknesses, their flammable fur makes them vulnerable to fire, which does twice as much damage to them.  That's about it.
>

name: MI Robot Knight
note:
<tjsLevel:2>
<cgmzdesc:
A simple humanoid robot, with magical artificial intelligence and electronics slammed together, protected by some heavy metallic armor.

These things don't hurt you very much, but trying to hurt them to get rid of them can be a pain.

They only suffer one-third normal damage from any physical attack, half as much damage from ice and cold-based attacks that their circuits can somewhat tolerate, and a quarter of normal damage from holy Light-based attacks.  Darkness and poison won't affect them at all.  Water-based attacks do a little more damage to them than most targets, and electrical attacks do double damage to them, shorting out their electronics.
>

name: MI Playground Machine
note:
<tjsLevel:5>
<tjsMeleeLevel:4>
<tjsBookLevel:4>
<tjsGunLevel:4>
<cgmzdesc:
An upgraded and more annoying friendly, playful robot, one that can be a bigger non-literal pain-in-the-neck than other robots of it's type.  This one of course won't actually cause pain in your neck, knowing that your skinny half-dragon boy teenage neck doesn't feel or sense pain thanks to your situation that makes you a "mutt" when it comes to your "breed," this robot can be a kind enough playdate in that it can solve half your problems if you don't like being a tall and skinny teenager - Specifically, it solves the "tall" part of it for you, as if.

No really, it's chances of getting your head to come off with a small stump of neck is even higher than it is with similar robots that haven't been upgraded like this one has been.  This robot has even more work put into it to REALLY get your decapitated head, pretty face, perfect skin, and beautiful freckles, with spiffy blond hair in a stylish flat top, into a very jealous Benny Zinkland's hands so he can do some perverted who-knows-what with it all day, every day, for the rest of your life.  Oh, and your friends all get killed.  That's also something he thoughtfully planned.

The fecal point of the thoughtfully planned out care plan for your decapitated head is the blatantly gratuitous dog poop diet.  Geez Benny, I mean COME ON.

Okay, to quickly look at this bot's ups and downs, its just like the other models that weren't upgraded, except it only takes half as much physical damage, it has beefed up shielding against magical attacks, it has a lot more Hit Points and speed, it can attack as much as five times in a combat turn in some cases, and it has TWO autocannons it uses, sometimes a 20mm like what the Stupid Little Annoying Turrets use, and also a sharper 22mm that does more flesh-cutting than the 20mm one.  It also has a standard physical melee attack that REALLY knows your neck and how to bisect it with precision, effeciency, and speed, far more easily than anything or anyone you've come across so far in Benny's magical virtual reality.  Kids at school who you swordfight with, who sometimes get your head to chop off, don't come even close.
>

name: Stupid Little Annoying Turret
note:
<tjsLevel:2>
<cgmzdesc:
Slow to react, once this mechanical pain starts itself up and puts some hot autocannon fire into your body, sometimes out the other side along with some of your parts, it attacks from one to three times with a decent chance of hitting most targets.

Other than hose you down with it's 20mm Auto Cannon like that, it doesn't do much else, but what it does that's already said can be bad enough.

Like other electronic and magical electronic robots and so on, it is immune to stuff like poison and Darkness based curses or attacks, suffers little damage from holy Light based attacks, only half as much from ice which can damage it but also cool off it's electronics nicely, and only 80 percent damage from physical attacks thanks to it's armor plating.

It suffers a little extra damage from water-based attacks, which mess up it's electronics, and is really weak against electrical attacks that can really do it in, inflicting twice as much damage as normal to it.

Nothing more to be said, really.
>

name: Playful Friendly Decapitation Bot
note:
<tjsLevel:2>
<cgmzdesc:
This robot apparantly has an obnoxious hard-on for taking your head right off, and only your head specifically, \P[1], with some violent act, and it can and will do that to a half dragon boy that happens to be you, and only you specifically, as you're on Benny Zinkland's ****-list, mentioned by name in this robots extermination orders, kiddo!

Okay, okay, anyways, the thing has some anti-magical shielding in it's armor plating, making it partially resistant to magical attacks of sorts (giving it magical defense), but only minor shielding at that, and it takes twice as much damage from electricity, which means it is weak against it of course, and more damage than normal from water-based attacks, which do about one-and-a-half times as much damage as normal.  Holy Light attacks only do a quarter damage, holy Darkness doesn't do squat and neither will poison.  Ice based attacks do only half damage to it.

The armor plating also makes it suffer only 60 percent damage from physical attacks, so it's a little more resistant to wear, tear, and punishment than some of the other robots designed by Benny Zinkland.

As such, its resistant to both magic and physical attacks, so either one might as well be used to stop it.

Oh, and it can keep you company by attacking you anywhere from one to four times in a combat turn.

Also, it decapitates a specific half dragon kid that it really wants to make shorter, a lot more easily than most other opponents.  This means that you can expect your neck to sever in a split second, popping your head clean off, a lot more often than when facing most other opponents.  This can be annoying as you may find yourself having to re-attach your head a lot after some horseplay with this robot.

By the way, some of these bots are killable, and others aren't.  The outdoor models quickly reset themselves and self-repair in a flash, but at least leave you alone after a fight, forgetting about you if you don't touch it again.

Some of the indoor ones are not the same with this, and no you do not have time to look for a model number and look it up in some reference manual you don't have anyways.  Besides, don't you want to get your head back on and get home?
>

name: Bash Bot
note:
<tjsLevel:2>
<cgmzdesc:
Oh, how thoughtful.  A playful robot beach ball that wants to play with you, except it isn't exactly a beach ball - No, this one's not light and filled with air, but HEAVY and armor-plated, like a darn battletank, as it shoots around through the air, smashing into you and breaking bones as it crushes you with every time it rushes at you and doesn't miss, kinda like an armor-plated heavyweight football player crossed with a freight train.

This robot attacks exclusively kamikaze-style, and is physically armored heavier than some of the other bots you've seen it around so that it can handle ramming crash-attacks over and over again while protecting it's inner electronic and magical guts.

It moves quick and fast, yet is heavy, so it impacts with this friggin' INERTIA that really hurts.  This makes it easy to miss with physical attacks, and it's armor plating is shielded at least partially against magic as well.

Like other robots that Benny Zinkland crafted, it suffers twice as much damage from electrical attacks and a little extra from water attacks that mess it up, but only half from ice attacks, a quarter from holy Light style attacks, and none from Darkness attacks and poison of any sort.

Unlike other robots made by Benny, it only suffers half normal damage from physical attacks, so its shielded quite well.
>

name: Rex
note:
<tjsLevel:5>
<tjsMeleeLevel:5>
<tjsMelee2Level:5>
<tjsBookLevel:4>
<tjsGunLevel:3>
<cgmzdesc:
Benny's pet boss monster.  Has a sharp one-handed axe wielded by a meaty arm that is bad enough without needing two hands.  Has a heavy pistol as well, and casts magic fire bolts at your party in combat, even though \P[1] is immune to them with his half-dragon anatomy.  Oh, and he casts self healing magic spells on himself when he gets injured below a certain threshold.  Tough against physical attacks, tougher still against ice attacks, weak putting up with Mana Force attacks like magi-guns and mana bolts, and very weak against fire attacks which can really do him in, hurting him with 250 percent damage compared to normal - Is it worth pointing out that he despises your firebreathing ability and what it can do to him?  Is it worth mentioning how much he despises you specifically?  Why, gosh, he just loves and adores you so much that he could help but show it by peeing all over your face, with your severed, decapitated head impaled on a wooden spike that made up part of a fence.  At least he didn't nail you to something and set it on fire, not that fire would actually burn or do any harm to your half-dragon self anyways...

Rex, at least in this form, attacks or acts anywhere from one to five times in one combat turn, FYI.

Not much more to be said, other than with firebreathing you can take him out easy, and beat him with your head already chopped off before the fight even begins.  Just make sure your head is still handy, in your hands if decapitated, so you can aim your face and the flames that come out of it's mouth.
>
